pages.title: City Hospital — Cardiology and Pediatrics Departments
pages.meta_description: Cardiology and pediatrics care at City Hospital.
pages.main_text: City Hospital offers Cardiology and Pediatrics departments.

pages.title: Cardiology Department — Heart Specialists
pages.meta_description: Same-day cardiology appointments with heart specialists.
pages.main_text: Our Cardiology department offers same-day appointments for heart specialist consultations. We accept insurance from most major providers. Popular with senior patients managing chronic conditions. Consultation fee is $150 without insurance.

pages.title: Pediatrics Department — Care for Children
pages.meta_description: Routine checkups and vaccinations for children.
pages.main_text: Our Pediatrics department provides routine checkups and vaccinations for children. We accept insurance. Telehealth video consultations are available for existing patients. Consultation fee is $100.

pages.title: New Patient Information
pages.main_text: New patients should bring identification and insurance information. We welcome new patients at all departments.
